messages:
Maya (SRE): following the DR postmortem, i'm opening this thread to lock owners and acceptance criteria for remediation items. please respond "owner | ETA | done" only.

Henrik (Net Eng): Henrik | 2026-04-10 | BGP + region-weight routing test harness in repo with a passing canary run against test-prefix-eu. Blocker: need net-sa permissions for test-prefix updates.

Zoe (Backups): Zoe | 2026-04-04 | daily cross-region restore job that verifies checksum parity and a sample read of key-value integrity in staging. Blocker: intermittent S3 read timeouts in eu-west-1 (ticket BACK-511).

Ibrahim (Oncall): Ibrahim | 2026-03-31 | runbook PR adding explicit KV priming step and a traffic-gate checklist; includes synthetic warmup snippet. DONE when PR merged and runbook link added to calendar invite.

Fatima (Platform PM): Fatima | 2026-04-20 | quarterly drill schedule + war-room template created, invites seeded. DONE when attendees confirm and war-room doc has fail/roll-forward decision tree.

Maya (SRE): ops note: to keep momentum, each PR must include the label `dr-followup-2026` and a one-line acceptance criteria in the body. I will run a weekly slotted review to greenlight merges.

Henrik (Net Eng): sample canary command:

```
# simulate region fail and assert fallback within 40s for test prefix
./routing-canary --prefix test-prefix-eu --simulate-fail eu-west-1 --assert-fallback 40s --dry-run
```

Zoe (Backups): restore cron example:

```
# nightly cross-region restore at 02:30 UTC
30 2 * * * /opt/redwood/bin/restore --snapshot latest --cluster staging --verify checksums --report /var/log/restore-report.json
```

Ibrahim (Oncall): KV priming snippet in runbook:

```
# synthetic warmup after restore: hit top-15 hot keys for 5m at 150rps
/opt/redwood/bin/warmup --keys top-15 --duration 5m --rps 150
```

Fatima (Platform PM): i've created a shared follow-up sheet and a sprint epic PLAT-DR-44. link dropped in pinned doc. please update row when you open PRs/tickets.

OpsBot: Reminder set: weekly follow-up update in #incidents every Mon 09:00 UTC.

Henrik (Net Eng): NET-3399 opened for net-sa access request and test-prefix ACLs. PR will follow.

Zoe (Backups): BACK-511 updated with logs; starting a trimmed restore to capture repro.

Ibrahim (Oncall): PR opened for runbook changes: https://git.redwood/repo/runbooks/PR-4402 (WIP). reviewers: Maya, Lee.

Maya (SRE): quick triage rule: if a blocker persists >72h, escalate in this thread and add `blocker-escalation` label on the ticket. we'll keep the weekly review until all items reach DONE.

Fatima (Platform PM): first drill tentative date: 2026-05-05. pre-checks due 2026-04-20. confirm by EOD Friday.

Henrik (Net Eng): confirmed. working on PR this week.

Zoe (Backups): will update BACK-511 with failing object keys and schedule triage. ETA for checksum fix investigation: 48h.

Ibrahim (Oncall): merging runbook PR after Maya's review; will include KV priming TTL of 48h in staging.

Maya (SRE): thanks all. i'll post a one-line weekly status in #incidents-summary until closure. reopen thread for escalations. :white_check_mark:

OpsBot: Thread archived and tagged `dr-followup-crossregion`.
